changes.title: Bounded shared-memory broadcast waits
changes.note: One commit, the adaptive-spin commit ce5f4148d4 of local-inference-lab/vllm#800, replayed on top of the prefetch commit. #800 now carries four commits and the other three are not part of this lock, so the entry names the pull request rather than claiming it in full. This base uses FlashInfer's CSF source/block APIs rather than the removed CsfScalePlanes API.

changes.title: Run the fused MXFP4 DSA indexer path
changes.note: FlashInfer main replaced the standalone MXFP4 score/select API with one fused plan/run call, so the DeepSeek V4.1 indexer takes it in both the forward path and the preparation callback. Scoring, top-512 selection and logical ordering now happen in one prepared run, which is also what the upstream fused implementation measured at a 37.26% median reduction against the staged route on SM120.

changes.title: Advisory disk row-cache prefetch for Qwen4Exp PLE and DeepSeek V4.1 Engram
changes.note: One switch, VLLM_PLE_PREFETCH=1, warms the host row cache ahead of the lookup through the pinned FlashInfer's DiskTable.prefetch and the ple_hash.host and engram.host row-id helpers.

changes.title: Prometheus metrics for the b12x row cache and prefetch
changes.note: Counters for hits, misses, residency, pool bytes and the prefetch queue, served on /metrics by vllm/v1/metrics/b12x_row_cache.py. The b12x caches are sampled on a daemon thread, never on the step path: reading them inline cost a 14 us median and a 3.6 ms worst case against the prefetch worker's lock, where the published snapshot costs 0.6 us. Totals are reported whether or not VLLM_PLE_PREFETCH is set, because the cache serves synchronous lookups either way.

changes.title: Resolve FlashInfer scale-swizzle intrinsics
changes.note: Use intrinsics.reference for NVFP4 and MXFP4 linear weight preparation with the pinned FlashInfer.

changes.title: Initialize pin-memory support after torch helpers
changes.note: Fix the lunar CPU-platform circular import exposed by the image CLI smoke.

changes.title: Rewrite flash_attn.cute imports to vllm.vllm_flash_attn.cute
changes.note: Packaging repair for this builder's symlink install path, which skips the import rewrite the upstream CMake copy performs. It carries no upstream change.

changes.title: C S3-FIFO host row cache for disk PLE/Engram tables
changes.note: Seven PR commits replayed onto main ea74ea610ce8 as cd736c5e3, then the caller-gated DiskTable.prefetch and host row-id commits, then five more that add prefetch telemetry to DiskRowCache.stats() — requests, rows queued and dropped, jobs, errors, and rows loaded or cancelled only as the worker really published or released them — and close two shutdown races where a close winning mid-call queued rows behind a stopped worker or made the worker release reservations through a dropped capsule. vLLM's prefetch hook and its metrics both need the row-cache commit 0b2e36842 or later. The range-diff against the previous lock is all-equal: the twelve commits replayed onto the new main without a single change.
